segments.name: Investment Management
segments.description: Alternative investment manager raising and managing private market funds across asset classes for institutional and individual investors in Latin America and globally.
segments.evidence: Investments in infrastructure, private equity, real estate and certain other assets may expose us to increased environmental liabilities that are inherent in the ownership of real assets.

revenueModel.text: Investors in the funds pay the company management fees, incentive fees and advisory and other ancillary fees for managing third-party capital.
revenueModel.evidence: FRE is calculated as net revenue from management fees, net revenue from incentive fees, net revenue from advisory and other ancillary fees and related taxes, less personnel expenses including rewards and bonus paid in cash and general and administrative expenses
